messages:
mika: Quick update — ran a 2% shadow/A-B for v3-int8 (candidate) vs v2p1 (prod) on longform summarization for ~4h. Small but consistent drift on a small slice; logging raw numbers below. Posting proposed tweaks to canary gates and an auto-fallback suggestion.

jeremy: Thanks — which metrics drifted? p95 latency, hallucination, or quality?

mika: Short summary: p95 latency +18% on longcontext requests (context > 8k tokens), average token cost ~+6%, and a ~0.6% absolute drop in ROUGE-L on the "legal-summaries" slice. Hallucination detector (rule-based) flagged +1.2% absolute increase on contract clause examples. Overall blended severity felt non-trivial for that slice.

tess: Do we have slices + sample ids? also how noisy are the evals (CI)?

mika: Slices: ["legal-summaries", meeting-minutes-long, qa-crossref]. Samples: LM-legal-0123..0140, MM-432..460. Eval noise: bootstrap CI on ROUGE-L for "legal-summaries" ~±0.25%. The 0.6% drop is outside the noise band.

rollout-bot: smokecheck summary: candidate v3-int8 shadow run finished — 2% traffic, 4 hours. Metrics extracted: p50/p95 latency, token-cost delta, slice ROUGE-L, hallucination-rate. No infra errors logged.

mika: Proposed gate changes (takeaway):
- For longcontext slices (>8k): tighten p95 latency rollback threshold to 15% (was 25%).
- For core quality slices (legal-summaries): require MRR/ROUGE-L absolute drop <0.3% to pass.
- Hallucination absolute increase >1.0% => immediate circuit-breaker.
- Cost per 1k tokens increase >8% triggers alert + manual hold.

jeremy: Those are sensible. Suggest we also add a composite "severity_score" so single small breaches don't auto-rollback but correlated breaches do. e.g. severity = 0.6*norm(rouge_drop) + 0.3*norm(halluc) + 0.1*norm(latency_pct). If severity > 0.2 -> auto-fallback.

dmitri: I'm fine with composite but want deterministic scaling. Proposed quick config (yaml):
```yaml
canary:
  traffic: 0.02
  duration: 4h
  thresholds:
    p95_latency_increase_pct: 15
    halluc_rate_abs_increase: 0.01
    rouge_l_absolute_drop: 0.003
    cost_per_1k_tokens_increase_pct: 8
auto_fallback: true
severity_weights:
  rouge_l: 0.6
  halluc: 0.3
  latency_pct: 0.1
severity_threshold: 0.2
```

mika: Example severity calc for the observed delta: rouge_drop=0.006 -> norm_rouge = 0.006/0.01 = 0.6 (we normalize by 1% expected max), halluc = 0.012 -> norm = 0.012/0.02 = 0.6, latency_pct = 18 -> norm = 18/50 = 0.36. severity = 0.6*0.6 + 0.3*0.6 + 0.1*0.36 = 0.456 -> above 0.2 -> auto-fallback would have triggered.

tess: Nice concrete calc. Two asks before we apply: (1) add per-slice weights (legal > meeting), (2) ensure rollback is gradual (drop to shadow instead of full rollback) for first auto action.

dmitri: We can implement per-slice weights: config will accept slice_weights map. For rollback stage we support: [reduce_traffic, pause_promotion, full_fallback]. Default auto action for severity in (0.2,0.5] -> reduce_traffic to 0.1%; >0.5 -> full fallback. We'll wire that in.

jeremy: Also add a gating metric for latency tail vs token cost tradeoff: if token-cost saving >12% and latency_increase <12% then allow exception (manual approve).

mika: Action items: (1) dmitri to add severity calculation + per-slice weights to canary service (ETA: today afternoon). (2) mika/tess to prepare a 20-sample counterexample set from legal-summaries for model team and ops to use in canary smokechecks. (3) jeremy to update docs with new thresholds + example calc.

tess: I'll do the counterexample set. tagging @mika when ready. :white_check_mark:

mika: Thanks. If rollout-bot can attach the run artifacts (raw eval logs + seed samples) to the ticket that'd be great.

rollout-bot: Attached artifacts to ticket RWD-1452: /artifacts/1713459999-shadow-run.zip (eval_logs.csv, sample_ids.txt, latency_profiler.json).

jeremy: Fine to close the loop once severity logic is in and docs updated. We'll avoid promoting v3-int8 until next shadow with updated gates. Done for now.
